Apple chip:       Apple M3 Pro
Chip family/SKU (policy):  1 base
Memory:           16 GiB
Memory tier:      constrained (physical standard)
Thermal class:    fanless
Throughput class: slow
Default model:    mlx-community/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct-4bit
Default context:  2048

Weights are not total unified memory. KV cache, runtime, and macOS sit on top.
fit is default (composed choice), fits, tight (measure first), or poor for this Mac.
cached is yes when that repo has config.json and every non-empty weight file on
disk (including all shards listed in model.safetensors.index.json when present).

fit	cached	model	weights	use
default	no	mlx-community/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct-4bit	~2.0-2.5 GB	Default chat on 8 GB and slow or moderate 16 GB
fits	no	mlx-community/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-4bit	~0.8-1.2 GB	Ultra-light prompts and classification
fits	no	mlx-community/Phi-3.5-mini-instruct-4bit	~2.2-2.8 GB	Compact instruct and coding assist
fits	no	mlx-community/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct-4bit	~2.0-2.6 GB	Multilingual and general chat
poor	no	mlx-community/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3-4bit	~4.0-5.0 GB	Default on fast cooled 16 GB; high swap risk on 8 GB
poor	no	mlx-community/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-4bit	~4.5-5.5 GB	General 8B work on fast cooled 16 GB and up
poor	no	mlx-community/Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-4bit	~8-10 GB	Heavier reasoning on very_fast 24 GB and up
poor	no	mlx-community/Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct-4bit	~18-20 GB	Large single-model server at 36 GB and up

One model at a time: scripts/serve-mlx.sh --model MODEL
